definitions.short: the south (from its drought); specifically, the Negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine)
definitions.full: H5045. negeb נֶ֫גֶב noun [masculine] ] south-country, Negeb, south (compare Lag BN 78 ); — ׳נ absolute Gen 20:1 +; construct Josh 11:2 +; נֶ֫גְבָּה Gen 13:14 +; — 1 south-country , i.e. a. specifically the region south of Judah, boundaries not exactly defined (see cities in it Josh 15:21-32 ), but with from hills south of Hebron to Kadesh, הַנּ ׳אֶרֶץ Gen 20:1 (E), 24:62 (J), Num 13:29 (JE), Judg 1:15 ; Josh 15:19 ; almost = proper name הַנֶּ֫גְבָּה ׳הַנּ, , Gen 12:9 ; 13:1 ; Num 13:17 , 22 ; 21:1 (all J), Deut 34:3 (JE), 1:7 ; Josh 10:40 ; 11:16 ; 12:8 (all D), Num 33:40 ; Josh 15:21 (both P), Judg 1:9 ; 1Sam 20:41 (but read הָאַרְגָּב , i.e. the mound ᵐ5 ( ἀργαβ ) Th We Klo Dr Kit Bu HPS), Jer 13:19 ; 17:26 ; 32:44 ; 33:13 ; Zech 7:7 ; Obadiah 20; Psa 126:4 (simile), Ezek 21:3 a (= Judah); ׳נ (no article) Gen 13:3 (J), 1Sam 30:1 ; see also Zech 14:10 ; נ ׳רָמַת Josh 19:8 , נ ׳רָמוֺת 1Sam 30:27 ; collective with plural verb = people of south-land Obadiah 19.. b. land south of Babylon Isa 21:1 (compare Di). c. = Egypt Dan 11:5-6 , 9 , 14 , 15 , 25 (twice in verse); 11:29 , 40 (see Meinh Bev Behrm, compare 11:43 ). 2 hence south (opposed to north, east, west) Gen 13:14 ; 28:14 (both J), Josh 17:10 (P), 1Kin 7:25 2Chr 4:4 ; 1Chr 9:24 ; 26:15 , 17 (compare 26:14 ;
